name: ombro
description: Ombro monorepo providing infrastructure for Skema services

scripts.pretest:e2e: docker compose -p skema-e2e-test --env-file .env.test --profile e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend:admin
scripts.install:backend: npm ci --prefix backend || npm install --prefix backend
scripts.install:frontend:admin: npm ci --prefix frontend/admin || npm install --prefix frontend/admin
scripts.install:frontend:web: npm ci --prefix frontend/web || npm install --prefix frontend/web
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend:admin
